The '''Gerinia system''' was located in the [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] known as [[Gerinian star-stone]].<ref name="Mandalorian">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Gerinian star-stone]]|system=Gerinia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gerinia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
